[SHEET 05.D] · LIMIT

Where the metaphor stops

  • Physics is narrower. The quantum observer effect means a measurement interacts with what it measures. It does not mean a mind creates reality, and it should not be borrowed as proof that cycles are real. [AUTHORED]
  • Reflexivity is not validation. That a belief about a cycle can move the cycle says nothing about whether the cycle exists. The 4th Turning criticisms already record the self-fulfilling-prophecy charge.
  • Regress. Observing the observer needs another observer. This page is itself an observation, and it has not been audited.
